answer: Each agent sets one anchor in tundra permafrost, locks a 65-credit bond, and files its forge heat number with a pull-test log of depth and peak load. An auditor recomputes pull resistance from depth and the tundra soil table and checks the heat number against the forge batch ledger; shortfall, reused heat number, or copied log burns the bond. First anchor 29 credits, kth 29+8(k-1), 1000th 8021; 1000 fakes cost 4025000 plus 65000 locked. An honest agent pays 29 once and recovers its bond after a clean epoch; a rented-anchor ring fails because each heat number backs one anchor and one epoch.
